verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a business financial platform, so a high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents multi-currency wallets, Global Accounts, and one-off or batch transfers, but nothing about a yield-bearing sub-account or recurring, rule-based sweeps into one. General transfer and batch-transfer features are adjacent and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can build a cash cushion in a high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules
